needs_user_permission_or_credentials.why: A memorable domain improves trust, repeat visits, and shareability versus a vercel.app URL.
Actual X/Twitter posting requires xurl CLI availability and OAuth credentials configured outside the agent session; never paste secrets into chat.
Paid tests require explicit budget, platform, and stop-loss rules before execution.

vercel_web_analytics.measurement_note: Vercel dashboard measures visitors, page views, referrers, geography, devices, and custom events without cookies.

ga4.event_bridge: assets/growth.js sends growth_exposure, growth_section_view, growth_engagement_summary, growth_click, and growth_share_copy_result through gtag when available, including session_id, anonymous visitor_id, visit_count, is_returning_visitor, days_since_first_seen, first/current UTM attribution, and destination link_utm_* fields for clicked/copied share paths.

internal_growth_events.purpose: A/B variant, anonymous visitor lifecycle, first/current UTM persistence, session_id, section visibility, engagement summary, share/copy/click/source events, destination link_utm_* attribution, and provider fan-out to Vercel Analytics and GA4.

sns_strategy.role: Drive BSS-owner repeat visits with concise, evidence-backed weekly item insights and UTM-tagged links.
sns_strategy.posting_rule_summary: After xurl is installed/authenticated, auto-post only safe evidence-backed ranking links within limits; keep replies/DMs/paid ads approval-only.
